title: Unify workspace UI and redesign on flat, borderless surfaces

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Directly briefed by the user in chat (Claude Code session), not the Cursor-agent Gherkin ritual. Frontend/visual redesign, no backend behavior change.

Two goals:
1. DRY the workspace UI: build one real shared component (web/components/workspace/) used by both the marketing hero (Hero.tsx, fed by scripted demo data) and the real authenticated app (EnabledWorkspace.tsx, fed by live API/SSE data), replacing WorkspacePrototype.tsx (a disconnected mockup) and the /chat app's separate chat.css dark theme.
2. Redesign the brand on flat, borderless surfaces: no borders/outlines/gradients anywhere; regions are rounded rects with flat background-color steps only (3 steps per mode: base/raised/highlighted), neither pure black nor pure white, light and dark symmetric via real prefers-color-scheme support (new — currently marketing is light-only and /chat is dark-only, disconnected).

Phased: 0) docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md + surface token system, 1) shared Workspace component, 2) restyle /chat onto shared tokens, 3) remove borders across ~14 marketing components, 4) verification. Each phase its own PR to develop. Plan: /Users/example/.claude/plans/yes-let-s-plan-this-atomic-river.md

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Phase 0 (brand guidelines + surface tokens, #197) and Phase 1 (shared WorkspacePanel component used by both the marketing hero demo and the real /chat app, #198) landed on develop. Also shipped along the way: message-bubble CTA shape (#196), and found+fixed a real pre-existing bug while deploying to production -- CloudFront was never invalidated on deploy (24h stale-cache window), fixed in #195.

Remaining: Phase 2 (restyle the rest of /chat -- MembershipShell and its panels -- onto the shared surface tokens, retire chat.css) and Phase 3 (remove borders across the ~14 marketing components still using them). Checking in with the user before continuing into that larger remaining scope.
